div.head: II Cn 45.2
div.ab: Þeowman gif wyrce, þolige his hyde oððon hydgyldes, be þam seo dæd sy.
Þeowman gif he weorce, þolige his hyde oððe hydgyldes, be þam seo dæd sy.
Si seruus operetur, corium amittat (suum perdat) — aut solutionem corii sui pro modo facti — uel XXX denariis redimat, secundum quod factum erit.
Ðeowman, gyf he wyrce, ðolie his hyde oððon hydgyldes, be ðam ðe seo dæd sy.
Þeowman gif wyrce, þolige his hyde oððon hydgyldes, be þam seo dæd sy.
Ein Unfreier, wenn er arbeitet, verliere seine Haut [erhalte Prügel] oder Hautgeld, je nachdem die That ist.
A slave, if he works, let him lose his hide [be flogged] or pay hide-money, according to what the deed is.
If a slave works, he shall undergo the lash or pay the fine in lieu thereof, according to the nature of the offence.
A slave, if he work, is to suffer a flogging or redeem himself from one, in proportion to the deed.
If a slave works, he shall suffer the lash or pay a fine in its stead, according to the nature of the deed.
